attributes.morphology: nearly spherical, elongated along swaging direction

evidence.quote: The microstructure of the annealed alloy consists of nearly spherical W grains with the γ phase distributed between them. Additionally, the W grains exhibit elongation along the swaging direction.
The results indicate that the 91 W-A900 alloy has the smallest W-W continuity and the largest volume fraction of the γ phase.
